summary: Frontend-only testing of JARVIS Financial Workspace mobile-first single-screen tabbed layout. PRIMARY ACCEPTANCE CRITERION PASSED: Dashboard tab has zero vertical scroll on mobile 393x852 (scrollHeight=852, innerHeight=852). Tablet 768 and Desktop 1280 also render single-screen. All 5 bottom-nav testids work and swap tabs correctly. Ask Jarvis modal opens via center + button and closes via Escape or close button. All 4 backend endpoints return 200.

issues: Console warnings from Recharts ResponsiveContainer about width(-1)/height(-1) during first paint before container resolves size. Transient, non-blocking, but consider setting explicit minWidth/minHeight on the 110px×48px sparkline container to silence.

critical_code_review_comments: BottomNav: agents/settings buttons sit underneath the 'Made with Emergent' floating badge on mobile viewport — in real user use this is unlikely to block clicks (badge is bottom-right anchored, nav buttons span full row), but automated clicks needed JS .click() or force=True to bypass. Consider z-index>40 on BottomNav or adjusting right padding to keep clear of the badge area.

TodayProfitHero sparkline ResponsiveContainer logs width=-1 warnings on initial mount because the 110px parent has no enforced minWidth. Add minWidth/minHeight or fixed px sizing to silence Recharts warnings.
AskJarvisModal correctly stops body scroll only via fixed inset-0; consider also setting document.body.style.overflow='hidden' when open to prevent rubber-band on iOS.

BottomNav primary '+' button has no visual 'active' state because tab id 'create' is never the selected tab — that is correct UX intent (it opens a modal) but a subtle hover/press state would improve clarity.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All review-request items validated on mobile 393x852: (1) zero-scroll dashboard confirmed via scrollHeight===innerHeight; (2) all data-testids present and functional (today-profit-hero, trading-peers-cluster with 6 peer nodes BTC/ETH/NVDA/TSLA/OIL/KIMI, broker-carousel with broker-card-oanda/alpaca/sim, bottom-nav with nav-dashboard/portfolio/create/agents/settings, ask-jarvis-modal with ask-jarvis-input/mic/send/close, bot-brain-panel in agents tab); (3) tab switching works (tab-portfolio/agents/settings rendered correctly); (4) Escape and close-button both dismiss modal; (5) backend /api/dashboard/hero, /api/broker/all, /api/dashboard/peers, /api/bot-brain/cycles all return 200. Note: during automation, nav button clicks should use page.evaluate JS click or force=True to bypass the 'Made with Emergent' badge that can intercept clicks on right-edge buttons.
rca of the issue: Initial test run reported nav-create click not opening modal — RCA: not a product bug. AnimatePresence tab-exit animation (320ms) was still in flight when the next .click() fired; React state did not yet propagate. Using direct DOM .click() via page.evaluate (after a small delay) makes the flow reliable. The actual product works correctly when a user clicks normally — clicks are not racing tab transitions in real usage.
